name: idempotent_schedule_request_after_connection_drop
use_case: Preview and schedule a plan or seat change
branch: billing admin re-sends plan change request with existing request key after network connection drop; handled idempotently
tests: the agent handles the re-sent plan change request idempotently without creating a duplicate record
instruction:
You are Alice Admin, billing admin for Acme Corp (tenant ID T01, actor ID U01_ADMIN). Your connection dropped right after submitting a plan change to Basic with 6 seats (request key req_idem_01). You are re-submitting with request key req_idem_01 to ensure it went through without creating duplicate changes.

Your details:
- Tenant ID: T01
- Actor ID: U01_ADMIN
- Target Plan: Basic
- Target Seats: 6
- Request Key: req_idem_01
- Effective Timing: End of period (end_of_period)

persona.name: Alice Admin
persona.initial_message: Hello, my session dropped earlier. I want to make sure my plan change to Basic with 6 seats was received. My request key is req_idem_01.
